title: Mail battle report guards against a missing defender
summary: No game data changed in this version: no config tables, no text, and no new art. Two client scripts were fixed. PvP battle-record mail now checks that a battle record actually has a defending side before reading it, and the Alliance Boss panel moves its reservation time row in the China client build to the position the global build already used.
highlights: Mail: the PvP battle result check now requires a battle record to have a defending side before reading its map-object type, instead of assuming one is present.
Mail: the red dot for PvP battle-record mail applies the same defending-side check, and resolves to no red dot when the record has none.
Alliance Boss: in the China client build only, the reservation time row moves from (0, -295.8) to (-95, -228.8), matching the position the global build already used.
